title: NOX METALS vs buymetal.com for Aluminum Plate
summary: buymetal.com sells metal online cut to size with no minimum orders, aimed at fabrication. NOX METALS stocks certified aerospace and defense plate with DFARS documentation and a committed ship date. A direct comparison.
body_markdown:
### Is buymetal.com the same company as Coremark Metals?


Public sources associate the two, and Coremark Metals operates production centers in Minneapolis and Fort Worth offering laser cutting, welding, and forming. We have not independently verified the corporate relationship, so confirm which entity is on your invoice and whose terms and certifications apply before placing a significant order.


### Does buymetal.com have a minimum order?


No. They state no minimum orders and sell standard or cut to size across a wide grade and shape range. NOX METALS also has no minimum, including on single pieces of 7075 and 7050.


### Does buymetal.com sell aerospace aluminum?


Their aluminum range is oriented toward general fabrication, including cast tooling plate, floor plate, and painted sheet, rather than aerospace structural alloys. For 7075 and 7050 plate in thick sections with mill certs, you want a supplier that stocks aerospace plate as a core category.


### Which one should I use if I need parts cut, not just plate?


Them. Their production centers do laser cutting, welding, and forming, so material and fabrication come from one vendor. We cut rectangles on bandsaws and do not fabricate parts.


### Which one gives me a ship date?


We do, per line item, at quote time. buymetal.com does not publish a ship date or a lead time before you order, which is true of six of the eight suppliers we surveyed.
